reply.emotion: curious and attentive, taking in the air around
notes: Sentir can mean both to perceive an odor with your nose and to experience a physical or emotional feeling.
When used reflexively as se sentir, it means to feel a certain way about your health or state of mind.

senses.definition: To perceive or notice an odor using your nose.

examples.text: Je peux sentir le pain chaud qui sort du four.
examples.translation: I can smell the warm bread coming out of the oven.
examples.emotion: hungry and eager, enjoying a delicious aroma

senses.definition: To experience a physical sensation or an emotion inside yourself.

examples.text: Il commence à sentir la fatigue après une longue journée.
examples.translation: He is starting to feel the fatigue after a long day.
examples.emotion: tired and heavy, dragging slowly through the end of the day

definitions: To perceive or notice an odor using your nose.
To experience a physical sensation or an emotion inside yourself.
